concept.title: Tire maintenance
concept.shortdesc: In addition to proper inflation, correct wheel alignment helps to prevent wear on the tires.

conbody.p: If you find a tire is worn unevenly, have your vehicle serviced by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
Make sure the newly installed tires are balanced correctly to increase vehicle ride comfort and tire life. In addition, always rebalance a tire when it is removed from the wheel.
